v4.6.80 — Day P/L = change since last market close

🐛 FIXED
• DAY P/L (and the 1D period) now measure the change since the LAST MARKET CLOSE (16:00 ET of the most recent trading day) — the way brokers show daily variation — instead of since UTC midnight. This fixes IBKR's overview showing little/no daily variation.
• 1D period stays identical to Day P/L by definition.

More improvements (per-account separation, server-only 24/7 bots, and a platform-wide polish sweep) are being scoped next.

Update via the in-app banner.
